info.title: Food Subscription & Ledger Management System
info.description: Production-grade, Clean Architecture REST API for Food Subscription & Ledger Management System.

get.description:
Fetches real-time dashboard data including:
- Today's Meal Operational Counts (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner with Veg/Non-Veg breakdown)
- Financial Summary Cards (Today's Collection, Pending Amount, Today's Revenue, Total Expenses, Profit = Revenue - Expenses)
- Active vs Paused customer counts.

post.description:
Creates a new customer profile.
Automatically initializes customer with active status.

get.description: Retrieves all active customers, with optional instant filtering by query string.

parameters.name: query

schema.description: Search term for name, phone, or address
schema.title: Query

parameters.description: Search term for name, phone, or address

get.description: Fetches detailed profile information for a single customer.

put.description: Updates editable fields of an existing customer profile.

delete.description: Soft-deletes / archives a customer profile without losing financial or delivery history.

post.description:
Creates a new subscription (Monthly, Weekly, Trial, Custom).
Automatically calculates start/end dates, Sunday holiday skips, custom rate overrides, and initial invoice.

get.description: Retrieves full details of a subscription including pending extension counters and calculated end date.

delete.description:
Cancels / soft-deletes a subscription (sets status = 'cancelled', is_deleted = True)
and calculates remaining credit adjustment for the customer.

get.description:
Fetches or auto-generates the daily delivery sheet for all active customer subscriptions.
Automatically applies meal rules and Sunday holiday skips.

post.description:
Cancels a specific meal (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner).
Triggers automatic or manual subscription extension (+1 meal working day skipping Sundays).
Returns rich metadata for frontend independence.
Generates an itemized invoice for a subscription based on selected meals, days, rates, and delivery charges.

Recalculates invoice after meal cancellations or early termination.
Computes consumed meals, unused credits, delivery adjustments, refund due, or pending amount.

get.description: Retrieves GPay-style double-entry ledger timeline, active invoice breakdown, payment history, total invoiced, total paid, and current pending balance.

post.description:
Records a payment against a customer's account (Cash, UPI, Bank Transfer, Cheque).
Generates a payment receipt number and updates the customer running balance.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a recorded payment (marks is_deleted = True) and adjusts customer running balance.

post.description: Records an operational expense (Groceries, Vegetables, Milk, Packaging, Transport, Salaries, Utilities).

put.description: Updates details of an existing operational expense record.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an operational expense record (sets is_deleted = True).

get.description: Generates detailed daily, weekly, or monthly financial and meal delivery breakdown reports.
Exports report metrics to a downloadable CSV file.

Fetches global business defaults:
- Default meal rates (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)
- Three meal lunch discount rate
- Sunday holiday toggle
- Default monthly subscription days (26 days)
- Default daily delivery charge

put.description: Updates global pricing, delivery, and holiday rules.
